chain_words.nuance: to bring together things one by one
to bring people or things into one place
to bring together and put in order as a whole
to call a formal meeting of people
to accumulate a large quantity of something over time

explanation: These words all describe bringing things or people together, from simple collecting to a large accumulation over time.

usage_notes.difference: 'Gather' means bringing people together informally or in general; 'convene' means calling a formal meeting for a set purpose.
